introHtml: Beacon cutting boards combine durable bamboo and wood materials with a trusted supplier known for quality craftsmanship. Ideal for corporate gifts, trade show giveaways, or employee appreciation, these boards can be laser engraved or screen printed with your logo. Choose from sizes like the 12" Grande or the Mini Bamboo for a versatile, eco-friendly promotional item that gets daily use in kitchens.
